units.source_text: 藤壶母后在一切贵人之中，心肠最为慈悲，对世人普遍爱护。

en.t: Among all noble people, Empress Mother Fujitsubo was the most compassionate, and she cared broadly for the people of the world.

units.source_text: 从来豪门贵族，总不免倚仗势力，欺压平民，藤壶母后则绝无此种行为。

en.t: Great noble houses had always tended to rely on their power and oppress common people, but Empress Mother Fujitsubo never behaved in such a way.

units.source_text: 四方有所贡献，凡劳师动众之事，一概谢绝。

en.t: When offerings came from every quarter, she refused anything that would trouble large numbers of people.

units.source_text: 在佛法功德方面，她也十分撙节：

en.t: In matters of Buddhist merit, she was also extremely restrained:

units.source_text: 从来富贵之人，经人劝请，往往穷极豪华地大做功德，

en.t: Wealthy and noble people had always, when urged by others, often performed acts of merit on a grand and lavish scale,

units.source_text: 即在圣明天子时代，亦不乏其例。

en.t: and even in the reigns of wise and enlightened emperors, such examples were not rare.

units.source_text: 惟有藤壶母后绝不做此等奢侈之事，她只用上代传下来的财宝，以及应得的年俸爵禄，

en.t: Only Empress Mother Fujitsubo never engaged in such extravagance; she used only the treasures handed down from earlier generations and the annual stipend and rank income properly due to her,

units.source_text: 在不妨碍其他用项的限度内，尽量普遍地斋僧供佛。

en.t: and within limits that did not interfere with other expenses, she supported monks and made offerings to the Buddha as widely as she could.

units.source_text: 因此无知无识的山僧，也都悼惜她的逝世。

en.t: For this reason, even simple and unlearned mountain monks mourned and regretted her passing.

units.source_text: 葬仪的消息，轰动全国，闻者无不悲伤。

en.t: News of the funeral shook the whole country, and everyone who heard it was filled with sorrow.

units.source_text: 凡殿上官员，一律身穿黑色丧服，使得这莺花三月暗淡无光。

en.t: All the court officials wore black mourning clothes, making this third month of warblers and blossoms seem dim and lightless.
